stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[2].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

normalized_weighted_grade.statement: Weights {a:1,b:1} and {a:50,b:50} give identical final grades; the final grade is the sum of score times weight divided by weight total.

letter_and_gpa.statement: Grades 90, 89.99(rounds to 90.00), 80, 70, 60, 59.99 map to A, A, B, C, D, F with GPA 4, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0.

class_stats.statement: For final grades 70, 80, 90 the output shows mean 80, median 80, stddev 8.16, highest 90, lowest 70.

cli_report.statement: Running the CLI on valid files exits 0 and prints one line per student with name, final grade, letter and GPA.

invalid_input.statement: Missing file, blank or non-numeric or out-of-range score, negative or all-zero weights, weighted assessment absent from the scores, and no students each exit 2 with a message on stderr.
